title: Hollow Vowel Drift
description: A hollow formant voice in the mid register that cycles through vowels while a band-pass sweep and slow vibrato breathe across the loop. Occasional reversed and half-speed notes warp the phrasing so the chant never settles, drifting like an alien throat-singer over a 24-cycle arc.
code:
setcpm(116/4)
stack(
  note("<c3 [c3 eb3] g3 <bb3 f3>>/2").s("sawtooth")
    .vowel("<a o u e i o>/3")
    .vib("<3 5 7>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.3, 1.8))
    .bpf(sine.slow(24).range(350, 2600)).resonance(sine.slow(17).range(8, 18))
    .crush("<16 12 8 10>/16").coarse("<1 1 2 1>/4")
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .sometimesBy(0.18, x => x.speed(-1))
    .sometimesBy(0.12, x => x.speed(0.5))
    .attack(0.02).decay(0.2).sustain(0.7).release(0.2)
    .off(1/6, x => x.add(note(7)).gain(0.3).vowel("i"))
    .delay("0.4:0.5:0.6").room(sine.slow(32).range(0.4, 0.85)).gain(0.7)
)
